title: NBFC loan file, one row per loan

notes.champion_score: The lender's existing score; higher = safer.
notes.default_12m: 1 if the loan reached 90+ days past due within 12 months of origination.
notes.dpd_history: One digit per month from origination: 0 current, 1 = 1-29, 2 = 30-59, 3 = 60-89, 4 = 90+.
notes.privacy: Do not include names, phone numbers, PAN or Aadhaar. loan_id is pseudonymised on ingest.
